analysis.summary: Sonam Limited reported a significant increase in financial performance for the first half of FY27, with revenue reaching Rs. 195 crores and profit after tax growing to Rs. 6.75 crores. Management highlighted that growth is driven primarily by domestic markets, premium range wall clock launches, and expanded trading activities, offsetting headwinds from higher export freight costs. The company targets full-year revenue of Rs.

guidance.claim: The company expects annual revenue to be around Rs. 300 crore to Rs. 350 crore.
guidance.quote: According to us revenue is around Rs. 300 crore to Rs. 350 crore. We hope it should be that.

guidance.claim: The company targets a PAT of Rs. 25 crore to Rs. 30 crore with an EPS of Rs. 5 to Rs. 6 by 2028-2029.
guidance.quote: Our plan is to provide maximum benefit to shareholders till 2028, 2029 and do PAT of Rs. 25 crore to Rs. 30 crore. And our EPS becomes Rs. 5 to Rs. 6.

guidance.claim: Management stated that full-year guidance will be 25% to 30% growth.
guidance.quote: you have given the guidance that full-year guidance will be 25% to 30% growth.

guidance.claim: Management expects that revenue for the next quarter will be around Rs. 40 crores to Rs. 50 crores minimum.
guidance.quote: For the next quarter we hope that revenue will be around Rs. 40 crores to Rs. 50 crores minimum.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that growth is coming more from domestic markets.
demand_outlook.quote: Actually, our growth is coming more from domestic.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand has been supported by the development of many new models that received a good response.
demand_outlook.quote: It is because of that. And the second thing is that according to domestic, we have developed a lot of models. So according to that, we have got a good response.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the 1st Quarter of FY27 reflected deadly demand across the product portfolio.
demand_outlook.quote: The 1st Quarter of FY’27 has been an increasing start to the financial year, reflecting strong operational performance, deadly demand across our product portfolio and our continuing commitment to innovation and customer satisfaction.

demand_outlook.claim: Management highlighted that export demand is going down due to the increase in price.
demand_outlook.quote: There is a little bit impact on export because export is going down due to the increase in price.

margins_costs.claim: Imported goods carry an average operating margin of 3% to 4%.
margins_costs.quote: Actually, in imported goods, we have an average margin of 3% to 4% and the average margin in trading activity and in manufacturing activity, there is 21% gross profit.

margins_costs.claim: Freight cost constitutes 30% to 40% of other expenses.
Raw material prices increased in the market, leading management to focus on business growth through special schemes and discounts.
margins_costs.quote: Actually, the raw material prices got increased in the market but we focused more on the business and by giving special schemes and special discount we grew the business.

margins_costs.claim: To reduce costs, the company is moving into the premium range to increase selling value.
margins_costs.quote: But, now to put the cost down we are going in the premium range. So, because of that our selling value will increase. So, cost will come down automatically after selling value increase.

margins_costs.claim: Our EBITDA margin stood at 6.07%, compared with 7.73% in the corresponding period last year.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA margin stood at 6.07%, compared with 7.73% in the corresponding period last year.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 8.06% and a PAT margin of 4.49% for Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 8.06% and a PAT margin of 4.49%, reflecting our continued focus on operation efficiency, disciplined cost management and sustainable profitability.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that margin side is fluctuating because daily raw material price is increasing and decreasing.
margins_costs.quote: Margin side is fluctuating because daily raw material price is increasing and decreasing. So, the margin is fluctuating a bit.

orders_capacity.quote: The capacity utilization for now is 52%.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that current manufacturing capacity utilization is 60% to 70%.

capital_allocation.claim: Dividend Paid (including corporate dividend tax) was -120.10 lakhs for 30-09-2026.
Management stated there are no requirements for funding future growth through additional borrowing for now.

risks_headwinds.claim: An increase in export freight costs has negatively impacted export volumes and manufacturing-level performance.
risks_headwinds.quote: Actually this year freight cost has increased in export. So, according to that export is a little less. There is an effect on export.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management mentioned a minor impact on exports due to price increases.
risks_headwinds.quote: There is a little bit impact on export because export is going down due to the increase in price.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to launch eight to ten new models in the coming two to three months.
management_commitments.quote: And we have launched a lot of new models in these two months. And in the coming two, three months we will launch eight to ten new models.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated its intention to develop items in the price range of Rs. 5,000 to Rs. 10,000 in the year 2027-28.
management_commitments.quote: So, our segment, our market planning is we will sell clock in the range of Rs. 5,000 to Rs. 10,000 and develop such items in this year, 2027-28.

management_commitments.claim: Management expressed hope that the 25% to 30% growth rate will be sustained for the rest of the year.
management_commitments.quote: Yes, we hope that 25% to 30% growth will be sustained. We have launched a lot of new products and there is a new line-up of new products.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
